In summary, our research is concerned with

the synthesis and characterization of new PLGA PEG block copolymer nano micelles as potential carriers of combretstatin like antitumor drugs and with the synthesis and in silico evaluation of benzothiazolane analogs of combretastatins.
the design of novel polymer micelles for the delivery of anticancer agents and the synthesis and biological evaluation of new benzothiazolones as potential combretastatin analogs.
the synthesis of new biodegradable block copolymeric materials and the synthesis and characterization of their micellar systems loaded with combretastatin derivatives as antitumor drugs.

the synthesis and investigation of the PLGA1000-PEG1000-PLGA1000 block polymer and the corresponding nano micelles is an important contribution to the field of biomedicine and pharmaceuticals.

the synthesis of new biodegradable PLGA PEG and PLGA polymer nano micelles and the study of their ability to form micelles and act as carriers for combretastatin analogs are very promising and should be continued.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we successfully designed and synthesized a novel biocompatible PLGA PEG PLA block copolymer, and we demonstrated that the obtained copolymer formed nanosized PLGA PEG PGLA micelles that can act as carriers for combretastatin-like antitumor agents, and that these micelles can deliver the drug to target cells.
we have successfully developed a novel drug delivery system based on PLGA PEG PLA block copolymeric micelles that could be used for the delivery of combretastatins.
we successfully developed a new biodegradable polymer nano micelles carrier for combretastatin analogues.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the obtained PLGA PEG PLA micelles have the ability to encapsulate the combretastatine like compound 16Z, and to deliver it into cells.
PLGA1000-PEG1000-PLGA1000 block polymer is a promising carrier for combretastatin-like antitumor agents, such as 16Z.
the obtained copolymer micelles can be used as drug delivery systems and can be used to target cells.
